source: Visitor Services — hours and ticketing desk (course mock)
exceptions: Open on Yale Commencement Monday and MLK Day despite the usual Monday closure.

admission.general: Free for individual visitors. No timed tickets.
admission.groups: K-12 field trips and other groups still need a reservation.

membership_faq.a: Yes. A free membership is available; patron groups are paid add-ons.
Members get program announcements and the option to RSVP to member-only programs when those programs are listed by Visitor Services. This desk does not publish after-hours gallery access on its own.

parking_note: Local construction limits on-site parking through Summer 2026. Weekday visitor parking is described as Lot 41 when open; tickets may need desk validation. This is a summary for the assignment, not a live parking map.
